label: Your LinkedIn profile link
hint: Paste the address from your profile page. The link is cleaned as you type. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
exampleIntro: Paste your own link above to clean it. This example comes from a messy country link with tracking text.
resultIntro: Copy the short form into your CV and put the full form behind it as the hyperlink.
shortNote: Type this as the visible text in your contact line. It is short and easy to read.
fullNote: Use this as the hyperlink behind that text, so a click opens your profile.
copyBlocked: Copy is blocked in this browser. Select the link and copy it.
previewHeading: How it looks in your CV header

removedItem.path: the language or page part after your name

issue.autoSuffix: Your link ends in a string of numbers or letters that LinkedIn added. A custom URL with just your name reads better on a CV. The steps are below.
issue.oddCharacters: Your link has characters other than letters, numbers and hyphens. Some PDF readers and applicant tracking systems break the link at those. A custom URL fixes it.
issue.tooShort: That handle is very short. Check you copied the whole address from your profile.

notLink: That does not look like a link. Paste the address from your profile page.
notLinkedIn: That is not a LinkedIn link. Paste the address from your LinkedIn profile page.
noHandle: The link stops after /in/. Copy the full address from your profile page.

notProfile.company: That is a company page. Paste the link to your own profile, the one with /in/ in it.
notProfile.school: That is a school page. Paste the link to your own profile, the one with /in/ in it.
notProfile.showcase: That is a showcase page. Paste the link to your own profile, the one with /in/ in it.
notProfile.posts: That is a link to a post. Paste the link to your own profile, the one with /in/ in it.
notProfile.feed: That is a link to your feed or a post. Paste the link to your profile, the one with /in/ in it.
notProfile.jobs: That is a job listing. Paste the link to your own profile, the one with /in/ in it.
notProfile.pulse: That is a link to an article. Paste the link to your own profile, the one with /in/ in it.
notProfile.pub: That is an old style profile link. Open your profile and copy the address from the browser, which now uses /in/.
notProfile.other: That link does not point at a profile. Profile links have /in/ followed by your name.
